advancedFooter: Overrides replace a preset setting for you. Loosening one needs your passkey and takes effect after 24 hours.
capsFooter: Lowering a limit applies immediately. Raising a limit needs your passkey, then applies immediately too.
customiseHint: Override individual settings instead of following the preset.

mandates.footer: Mandates let bills inside their limits pay themselves.
mandates.invalidAmount: Enter amounts above zero. Per payment cannot be more than per period.
mandates.newBody: Pick a verified payee and set limits. Creating a mandate needs your passkey and takes effect after 24 hours.
mandates.noVerifiedPayees: Add and verify a payee first.
mandates.revokeBody: Revoking stops automatic payments under this mandate straight away.
mandates.scope: Up to {{perPayment}} per payment and {{perPeriod}} per {{period}} for {{categories}}
mandates.title: Mandates

paymentsFooter: Money mode and payment approval decide how payments are made.
pendingToastBody: This loosens a rule. It takes effect after 24 hours.

SMART.title: Smart
SMART.body: Small safe payments to verified payees run automatically. Risky ones ask.

AUTOPILOT.title: Autopilot
AUTOPILOT.body: Bills inside your signed mandates pay themselves.

title: Settings

backupCodes.title: Backup codes
backupCodes.footer: If you lose every device with your passkey, a backup code lets you set up a new passkey. Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe, like a password manager or on paper.
backupCodes.regenerate: Create new codes (old ones stop working)
backupCodes.shownOnce: Save these now. They will not be shown again.

data.title: Import & export
data.rowHint: Your data as JSON, or bring it from another app
data.exportFooter: Your cards, budgets, bills, incomes and spending as a JSON file you can keep or import again.
data.importFooter: A Kassa export, or JSON from your bank or another money app. Kassa finds the records and matches their fields (any language), then shows you what it will add before anything changes.
data.fromKassa: A Kassa export: everything is read exactly.
data.budgetsNote: Raising a budget needs your passkey.
data.done: Spending: {{imported}} added, {{duplicates}} already there, {{failed}} not readable. Bills: {{bills}}. Cards: {{cards}}. Budgets: {{budgets}}. New bills' payees need account details before Kassa can pay them.
